links.outcome: Regulatory compliance and factual accuracy of ICFs with retrieval-augmented pipeline vs baseline LLMs
links.effect: Baseline LLMs (e.g., GPT-4o) achieved 70%-80% compliance with factual errors in 18%-43% of cases; InformGen (retrieval-augmented, human-in-the-loop) achieved nearly 100% compliance and over 90% factual accuracy.
links.quote: In contrast, InformGen substantially improved outputs, achieving nearly 100% regulatory compliance and over 90% factual accuracy, as validated by 5 domain-expert annotators.

links.outcome: LLM-generated consent form accuracy and compliance assessed against regulatory guidelines and templates with expert annotators
